The workshop slides, in the order they are presented:

1. [Intro](workshop-intro-day-1.html): welcome, schedule, team and code of conduct
2. [Unix](unix-shell-introduction.html): Unix shell introduction
3. [Git intro](git-intro-lesson.html): version control with Git
